# deployment-profile

<!-- Generated by tools/config-reference.py from libs/platform/src/main/resources/META-INF/oidf-settings/deployment-profile.json. Do not edit: change the catalogue, then run python3 tools/config-reference.py. -->

The settings of the `deployment-profile` component of `libs/platform`, read by package `com.pingidentity.ps.oidf.platform.profile`: generated from its catalogue, [deployment-profile.json](../../libs/platform/src/main/resources/META-INF/oidf-settings/deployment-profile.json), by `tools/config-reference.py`, and checked in CI. [How to read a row](README.md#reading-a-row).

Families: `OIDF_DEPLOYMENT_`, `OIDF_ACCEPTED_`. A name under one of these that no catalogue declares is an unknown key.

| Setting | Default | What it does | When it's wrong | Profile | Security |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `OIDF_DEPLOYMENT_PROFILE` | `production`; one of `development`, `production` | The profile this process runs under: development, or production, which is also what unset means | **Not checked**: Anything but development, in any case and trimmed, runs as production; rar-model alone reads development only when it is written exactly so (F-0160) | Any | Yes |
| `OIDF_ACCEPTED_RISKS` | Unset; a list | The risky switches this deployment accepts in production, comma-separated, each a risk id alone or with the last day it holds (expiry-log-mode@2026-12-31, UTC) | **Not checked**: An entry that is empty, not a risk this release knows, dated wrongly or past its date, repeated, or without the date a dated risk needs is not accepted, and the start-up audit lists it; nothing refuses a deployment for it until PR-5 | Any | Yes |
